navigation._derivation: Suite design tuning for a thin floating search/navigation bar: squircle bevel, modest refraction and fill, readable over both authored plates.

toggle._derivation: Suite design tuning for a compact switch: lip profile, short bezel and stronger edge light make the small control legible.

slider._derivation: Suite design tuning for an active horizontal control: circular bevel, low blur and increased gain expose the edge displacement.

player._derivation: Suite design tuning for a media panel: larger radius, deeper body and higher opaque fill prioritize album/text readability.

loupe._derivation: Suite design tuning for a circular inspection lens: equal dimensions, thick circular bevel and high gain emphasize magnification without an external preset.

panelA._derivation: Suite design tuning for the project's notification banner: wide squircle, moderate blur and shallow gain preserve a crisp information hierarchy.

panelB._derivation: Suite design tuning for the project's floating menu: tall lip profile, deeper dim and stronger directional rim separate actions from scrolling content.
